from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import logging
import time
from datetime import timedelta
from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

from . import constants as C
from . import prompts
from .models import (
    AgendaItem,
    AutonomyConfig,
    AutonomyState,
    ShiftReport,
    is_due,
    parse_iso,
    utcnow,
    utcnow_iso,
)
from .store import AutonomyStore

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

MAX_DESCRIPTION_CHARS = 2000
MAX_MESSAGE_CHARS = 1000

#: A runner receives the shift chat (already created) and the system prompt.
TurnRunner = Callable[..., Any]


def _clip(value: Any, max_chars: int) -> str:
    """Clip a value to *max_chars*."""
    text = ("" if value is None else str(value)).strip()
    if len(text) <= max_chars:
        return text
    return text[:max_chars].rstrip() + "…"


class AutonomyService:
    """
    Runs and reports the autonomous agents of one project.

    Args:
        settings: Project settings.
        chat_manager: Optional ``ChatManager`` (built lazily).
        event_manager: Optional event manager for live UI notifications.
        store: Optional :class:`AutonomyStore` (tests).
        runner: Optional async callable replacing the real agent turn (tests).
        user: Optional ``CodxUser`` used by the AI call.
        agent_turn_model: Optional model override applied to every shift.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        settings: Any,
        chat_manager: Any = None,
        event_manager: Any = None,
        store: Optional[AutonomyStore] = None,
        runner: Optional[TurnRunner] = None,
        user: Any = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.settings = settings
        self.chat_manager = chat_manager
        self.event_manager = event_manager
        self.user = user
        self.store = store or AutonomyStore(getattr(settings, "codx_path", ""))
        self._runner = runner

    # -- dependencies -----------------------------------------------------

    def _manager(self) -> Any:
        """Return (creating if needed) the project ChatManager."""
        if self.chat_manager is None:
            from codx.junior.chat_manager import ChatManager

            self.chat_manager = ChatManager(settings=self.settings)
        return self.chat_manager

    def _profiles(self) -> Any:
        """Return the project ProfileManager."""
        from codx.junior.profiles.profile_manager import ProfileManager

        return ProfileManager(settings=self.settings)

    def _runner_for(self) -> TurnRunner:
        """Return the injected runner or the real agent turn."""
        return self._runner or self._run_agent_turn

    # -- catalogue --------------------------------------------------------

    def agents(self) -> Dict[str, Tuple[Any, AutonomyConfig]]:
        """
        Return the autonomous profiles of the project.

        Returns:
            ``{profile_name: (Profile, AutonomyConfig)}`` for every profile whose
            ``autonomy`` block is enabled. A profile that cannot be read is
            skipped (the catalogue is never a single point of failure).
        """
        agents: Dict[str, Tuple[Any, AutonomyConfig]] = {}
        try:
            profiles = self._profiles().list_all_profiles() or []
        except Exception as ex:  # pragma: no cover - defensive
            logger.exception("autonomy: cannot list profiles: %s", ex)
            return agents
        for profile in profiles:
            config = AutonomyConfig.from_profile(profile)
            if not config.enabled:
                continue
            name = str(getattr(profile, "name", "") or "").strip()
            if not name:
                continue
            agents[name] = (profile, config)
        return agents

    def resolve_agent(self, agent: str) -> Tuple[str, Any, AutonomyConfig]:
        """
        Resolve an agent by profile name (case insensitive).

        Raises:
            ValueError: When the profile does not exist or is not an agent.
        """
        wanted = str(agent or "").strip().lstrip("@")
        if not wanted:
            raise ValueError("agent is required")
        agents = self.agents()
        for name, (profile, config) in agents.items():
            if name.lower() == wanted.lower():
                return name, profile, config
        known = ", ".join(agents) or "none"
        raise ValueError(
            f"'{wanted}' is not an autonomous profile (agents: {known}). "
            f"Enable autonomy on the profile first."
        )

    # -- board ------------------------------------------------------------

    def ensure_board(self, config: AutonomyConfig) -> str:
        """
        Create the agent board (with its columns) when it does not exist yet.

        Reuses the very same helpers the ``project_manager`` tool uses, so the
        catalogue, the storage folders and the UI stay consistent.

        Returns:
            The board title.
        """
        board_name = str(config.board or "").strip()
        if not board_name:
            return ""
        try:
            from codx.junior.tools import project_manager_tools as pm

            manager = self._manager()
            kanban = pm._load_kanban(manager)
            by_name = pm._board_catalogue(kanban=kanban)
            if pm._match_board(by_name=by_name, board=board_name) is not None:
                return board_name
            titles = list(C.DEFAULT_COLUMNS)
            entry = pm._new_board_entry(
                name=board_name,
                description=f"Autonomous agent board ({board_name})",
                columns=titles,
                board_type="kanban",
                parent_id=None,
            )
            raw_boards = pm._kanban_boards(kanban)
            if isinstance(raw_boards, list):
                entry["name"] = board_name
                raw_boards.append(entry)
            else:
                raw_boards[board_name] = entry
            pm._save_kanban(chat_manager=manager, kanban=kanban)
            pm._ensure_board_folders(
                chat_manager=manager, board_name=board_name, columns=titles
            )
            logger.info("autonomy: created agent board '%s'", board_name)
        except Exception as ex:  # pragma: no cover - board creation is best effort
            logger.warning("autonomy: cannot ensure board '%s': %s", board_name, ex)
        return board_name

    def collect_tasks(
        self, board: str, config: AutonomyConfig, now: Optional[Any] = None
    ) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Return the board snapshot handed to the agent."""
        moment = now or utcnow()
        snapshot: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        for chat in self._manager().list_chats() or []:
            if str(getattr(chat, "board", "") or "").strip() != board:
                continue
            if getattr(chat, "is_template", False):
                continue
            if str(getattr(chat, "mode", "") or "").strip().lower() == "channel":
                continue
            snapshot.append({
                "id": str(getattr(chat, "id", "") or ""),
                "name": _clip(getattr(chat, "name", ""), 300),
                "description": _clip(getattr(chat, "description", ""), MAX_DESCRIPTION_CHARS),
                "last_message": self._last_message(chat),
                "column": str(getattr(chat, "column", "") or ""),
                "status": str(getattr(chat, "status", "") or ""),
                "wake_at": str(getattr(chat, "wake_at", "") or ""),
                "priority": str(getattr(chat, "priority", "") or ""),
                "due_date": str(getattr(chat, "due_date", "") or ""),
                "progress": int(getattr(chat, "progress", 0) or 0),
                "created_at": str(getattr(chat, "created_at", "") or ""),
                "updated_at": str(getattr(chat, "updated_at", "") or ""),
                "done": self._is_closed(chat),
                "due_now": is_due(getattr(chat, "wake_at", ""), moment),
            })

        # Due and open tasks first, then the most recently touched ones: when the
        # board has more cards than the prompt budget, the shift must see the
        # work that needs it now.
        snapshot.sort(key=lambda task: task.get("updated_at") or "", reverse=True)
        snapshot.sort(key=lambda task: 0 if task.get("due_now") else 1)
        snapshot.sort(key=lambda task: 1 if task.get("done") else 0)
        limit = max(1, min(config.max_agenda * 4, C.MAX_TASKS_LIMIT))
        return snapshot[:limit]

    def due_agenda(
        self, board: str, config: AutonomyConfig, now: Optional[Any] = None
    ) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Return the tasks of *board* whose ``wake_at`` is due."""
        moment = now or utcnow()
        items = [
            task
            for task in self.collect_tasks(board, config, now=moment)
            if task.get("due_now") and not task.get("done")
        ]
        items.sort(key=lambda task: task.get("wake_at") or "")
        return items[: max(1, config.max_agenda)]

    @staticmethod
    def _is_closed(chat: Any) -> bool:
        """Return True when the task is finished and must never wake again."""
        status = str(getattr(chat, "status", "") or "").strip().lower()
        if status in C.CLOSED_STATUSES:
            return True
        return bool(getattr(chat, "done", False))

    @staticmethod
    def _last_message(chat: Any) -> str:
        """Return the last visible message content of *chat*."""
        for message in reversed(getattr(chat, "messages", []) or []):
            if getattr(message, "hide", False):
                continue
            content = _clip(getattr(message, "content", ""), MAX_MESSAGE_CHARS)
            if content:
                return content
        return ""

    # -- schedule ---------------------------------------------------------

    def next_wake_at(self, config: AutonomyConfig, state: AutonomyState) -> str:
        """Return the next planned wake of the agent (empty when disabled)."""
        if not config.enabled or state.running:
            return ""
        planned = parse_iso(state.wake_at)
        if planned is not None:
            return planned.isoformat()
        last = parse_iso(state.last_shift_at)
        if last is None:
            return utcnow_iso()
        return (last + timedelta(minutes=config.interval_minutes)).isoformat()

    def is_due(
        self, config: AutonomyConfig, state: AutonomyState, now: Optional[Any] = None
    ) -> bool:
        """Return True when the agent should take a shift now."""
        if not config.enabled:
            return False
        if state.wake_requested:
            return True
        # A shift can run for minutes; a "running" state is only abandoned when
        # it is far older than the runtime limit.
        if state.running:
            started = parse_iso(state.last_shift_at)
            if started is not None:
                age = ((now or utcnow()) - started).total_seconds()
                limit = max(C.STALE_SHIFT_SECONDS, config.max_runtime_minutes * 60 + 300)
                if age < limit:
                    return False
        planned = parse_iso(state.wake_at)
        if planned is not None:
            return planned <= (now or utcnow())
        last = parse_iso(state.last_shift_at)
        if last is None:
            return True
        return (now or utcnow()) >= last + timedelta(minutes=config.interval_minutes)

    # -- status -----------------------------------------------------------

    def status(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Return the configuration + runtime state of every agent."""
        stored = self.store.load().get("agents") or {}
        entries: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        for name, (profile, config) in self.agents().items():
            try:
                state = AutonomyState(**(stored.get(name) or {}))
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                state = AutonomyState(agent=name)
            entries.append({
                "agent": name,
                "board": config.board,
                "description": _clip(getattr(profile, "description", ""), 400),
                "avatar": str(getattr(profile, "avatar", "") or ""),
                "linked_profiles": list(getattr(profile, "profiles", []) or []),
                "model": str(getattr(profile, "llm_model", "") or ""),
                "config": config.model_dump(),
                "state": state.public(),
                "due": self.is_due(config, state),
                "next_wake_at": self.next_wake_at(config, state),
            })
        return {
            "agents": entries,
            "worker_present": self.store.worker_present()
            or any(entry["state"].get("running") for entry in entries),
            "defaults": {
                "interval_minutes": C.DEFAULT_INTERVAL_MINUTES,
                "mode": C.DEFAULT_MODE,
                "max_agenda": C.DEFAULT_MAX_AGENDA,
                "max_runtime_minutes": C.DEFAULT_MAX_RUNTIME_MINUTES,
                "columns": list(C.DEFAULT_COLUMNS),
            },
        }

    def request_wake(self, agent: str, when: str = "") -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Record "take a shift now" (or at *when*) for *agent*.

        The API never runs a shift inline: it writes the intent and the
        background worker executes it, exactly like the orchestration runtime.
        """
        from .models import parse_when

        name, _profile, config = self.resolve_agent(agent)
        wake_at = parse_when(when) if when else ""
        state = self.store.request_wake(name, board=config.board, wake_at=wake_at)
        self._emit(name, "wake", "Shift requested", board=config.board)
        return {
            "queued": True,
            "agent": name,
            "board": config.board,
            "wake_at": wake_at,
            "state": state.public(),
        }

    def schedule_wake(self, agent: str, when: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Set the next planned wake of *agent* (the agent schedules itself)."""
        from .models import parse_when

        name, _profile, config = self.resolve_agent(agent)
        wake_at = parse_when(when)
        if not wake_at:
            raise ValueError(f"cannot understand the schedule '{when}'")
        state = self.store.set_wake_at(name, wake_at)
        self._emit(name, "scheduled", f"Next shift scheduled at {wake_at}", board=config.board)
        return {"agent": name, "board": config.board, "wake_at": wake_at, "state": state.public()}

    # -- shifts -----------------------------------------------------------

    async def run_due(self, force: bool = False) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Take a shift with every agent that is due (or every agent when forced)."""
        results: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        for name, (_profile, config) in self.agents().items():
            state = self.store.get_state(name)
            if not force and not self.is_due(config, state):
                continue
            results.append(await self.run_shift(name, force=True))
        return results

    async def run_shift(
        self,
        agent: str,
        *,
        force: bool = False,
        trigger: str = "schedule",
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Run one shift of *agent*.

        Args:
            agent: Profile name of the agent.
            force: Run even when the schedule says it is not due.
            trigger: What caused the shift (``schedule``, ``wake``, ``task``).

        Returns:
            The public payload of the agent (config, state, board, agenda).
        """
        try:
            name, profile, config = self.resolve_agent(agent)
        except ValueError as ex:
            return {"agent": agent, "error": str(ex)}

        with self.store.shift_lock(name) as acquired:
            if not acquired:
                return self._payload(name, profile, config, self.store.get_state(name))

            board = self.ensure_board(config)
            state = self.store.mutate_state(name, lambda current: self._started(current, name, board))
            self._emit(name, "started", "Shift started", board=board)

            started = time.monotonic()
            report = ShiftReport(agent=name, board=board)
            agenda: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
            try:
                tasks = self.collect_tasks(board, config)
                agenda = [
                    task for task in tasks
                    if task.get("due_now") and not task.get("done")
                ][: max(1, config.max_agenda)]
                report.agenda = [
                    AgendaItem(
                        chat_id=task["id"],
                        name=task["name"],
                        wake_at=task.get("wake_at") or "",
                    )
                    for task in agenda
                ]

                system = prompts.build_shift_system(
                    agent=name,
                    board=board,
                    instructions=self._instructions(profile, config),
                    budget=config.budget_cxjcoins,
                    minutes=config.max_runtime_minutes,
                    dry_run=config.mode == C.MODE_DRY_RUN,
                )
                prompt = prompts.build_shift_prompt(
                    agent=name,
                    board=board,
                    now=utcnow_iso(),
                    trigger=trigger,
                    shift_number=state.shifts,
                    last_shift=state.last_summary,
                    instructions=self._instructions(profile, config),
                    agenda=agenda,
                    tasks=tasks,
                )

                if config.mode == C.MODE_DRY_RUN:
                    content, cost, shift_chat = await self._dry_run(
                        name=name, board=board, system=system, prompt=prompt,
                        agenda=agenda, timeout_minutes=config.max_runtime_minutes,
                    )
                else:
                    content, cost, shift_chat = await self._active_turn(
                        name=name, board=board, system=system, prompt=prompt,
                        agenda=agenda, timeout_minutes=config.max_runtime_minutes,
                    )

                report.shift_chat_id = str(getattr(shift_chat, "id", "") or "")
                report.summary = _clip(self._summary_from(content), 8000)
                report.report = _clip(content, 20000)
                report.cost_cxjcoins = cost
                report.status = C.STATE_OK
            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                report.status = C.STATE_ERROR
                report.error = (
                    f"The shift exceeded {config.max_runtime_minutes} minutes and "
                    "was cancelled"
                )
            except Exception as ex:  # pragma: no cover - defensive
                logger.exception("autonomy: shift of '%s' failed: %s", name, ex)
                report.status = C.STATE_ERROR
                report.error = str(ex)
            finally:
                # The wake is always consumed: a due task that keeps waking the
                # agent forever is worse than a wake lost to an error, and the
                # agent may have rescheduled it during the shift (that wake is
                # preserved by _consume_agenda).
                self._consume_agenda(agenda)

            report.duration_seconds = time.monotonic() - started
            state = self.store.get_state(name)
            state.mark_finished(report)
            fallback = self.next_wake_at(config, state)
            if not state.wake_at:
                state.wake_at = fallback
            self.store.put_state(name, state)
            self._emit(name, "finished", report.report or report.error, board=board,
                       status=report.status, cost=report.cost_cxjcoins)
            logger.info(
                "autonomy: shift of '%s' finished status=%s cost=%.6f duration=%.1fs",
                name, report.status, report.cost_cxjcoins, report.duration_seconds,
            )
            return self._payload(name, profile, config, state)

    async def _active_turn(
        self,
        *,
        name: str,
        board: str,
        system: str,
        prompt: str,
        agenda: List[Dict[str, Any]],
        timeout_minutes: int,
    ) -> Tuple[str, float, Any]:
        """Create the shift card and run one real agent turn on it."""
        chat = self._create_shift_card(name=name, board=board, prompt=prompt, agenda=agenda)
        runner = self._runner_for()
        timeout = max(60, int(timeout_minutes) * 60)
        await asyncio.wait_for(runner(chat=chat, system=system), timeout=timeout)
        content, cost = self._read_turn(chat)
        self._close_shift_card(chat)
        return content, cost, chat

    async def _dry_run(
        self,
        *,
        name: str,
        board: str,
        system: str,
        prompt: str,
        agenda: List[Dict[str, Any]],
        timeout_minutes: int,
    ) -> Tuple[str, float, Any]:
        """
        Read-only shift: no tools, no card changes, just the report.

        A dry run is the honest way to preview an agent: the model cannot touch
        anything because it is called directly instead of through the agent
        loop (which is what exposes the tools).
        """
        chat = self._create_shift_card(
            name=name, board=board, prompt=prompt, agenda=agenda,

                content = str(getattr(message, "content", "") or "")
                break

        except (TypeError, ValueError):

    def _consume_agenda(self, agenda: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
        """
        Clear the ``wake_at`` of the delivered tasks.

        The agent may have rescheduled itself (its own ``wake_at``) or created
        new scheduled tasks during the shift; only the tasks that were *due* are
        consumed here, so a follow-up the agent wrote during the shift survives.
        """
        for item in agenda or []:
            chat_id = str(item.get("id") or item.get("chat_id") or "")
            if not chat_id:
                continue
            try:
                chat = self._manager().find_by_id(chat_id=chat_id)
            except Exception as ex:  # pragma: no cover - defensive
                logger.debug("autonomy: cannot read task '%s': %s", chat_id, ex)
                continue
            if chat is None:
                continue
            current = str(getattr(chat, "wake_at", "") or "")
            if current and not is_due(current):
                # The agent scheduled it for later: respect that.
                continue
            try:
                chat.wake_at = ""
                self._manager().save_chat(chat=chat)
            except Exception as ex:  # pragma: no cover - defensive
                logger.warning("autonomy: cannot consume wake of '%s': %s", chat_id, ex)

MAX_ATTACHMENT_SIZE_MB = MAX_IMAGE_SIZE_MB

    'image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/jpg', 'image/gif', 'image/webp', 'image/svg+xml'
]
ALLOWED_AUDIO_TYPES = [

    'audio/x-wav', 'audio/x-m4a', 'audio/m4a', 'audio/aac', 'audio/flac'
]
ALLOWED_ATTACHMENT_TYPES = ALLOWED_IMAGE_TYPES + ALLOWED_AUDIO_TYPES


class ChatAttachment(BaseModel):
    """Represents a media file (image or audio note) attached to a chat or message,
    with its metadata and base64 encoded data."""
    file_name: str = Field(description="Original file name of the attachment")
    file_type: str = Field(description="MIME type (e.g., 'image/png', 'audio/webm')")
    file_size: int = Field(description="File size in bytes")
    base64_data: str = Field(description="Base64 encoded file data")
    uploaded_at: str = Field(default_factory=lambda: str(datetime.now()), description="Timestamp when the attachment was uploaded")
    
    @validator('file_size')
    def validate_file_size(cls, v):
        if v > MAX_ATTACHMENT_SIZE_BYTES:
            raise ValueError(f"Attachment size exceeds maximum allowed size of {MAX_ATTACHMENT_SIZE_MB}MB")
        return v
    
    @validator('file_type')
    def validate_file_type(cls, v):
        # `MediaRecorder` reports the recording type together with its codec list
        # ("audio/webm;codecs=opus"). Attachments store the container type only,
        # so the parameters are stripped before validating (and persisting).
        media_type = (v or '').split(';')[0].strip().lower()
        if media_type not in ALLOWED_ATTACHMENT_TYPES:
            raise ValueError(

class Message(BaseModel):
    """
    A single chat message.

    Tool and run-lifecycle events emitted while generating an assistant
    response are ASSOCIATED with that response message (they are NOT separate

    - ``tool_events``:      one :class:`ToolEvent` per tool call executed

                            tool's user-facing ``output`` (see below) so clients
                            can render tool output collapsed/hidden without it
                            polluting ``content``.
    - ``lifecycle_events``: one :class:`LifeCycleEvent` per agent run
                            performed to produce this response.

    Both lists are streamed in real time together with the message and are
    persisted with the chat.

    **Tool output (`tool_events[].output`)**

    Tool output (``ToolResponse.user_response``) is NOT merged into
    ``content``. It is attached to the response message as the
    :attr:`ToolEvent.output` property (streamed live with every message event
    and persisted with the chat) so the client decides whether to show it
    inline, collapsed, or hidden.

    **Cost Tracking (`cost` / `cost_info` fields)**

    ``cost`` records the cost, in cxjcoins, of the AI iteration that produced
    this message. SmolAgent registers the FULL processing cost of the response
    here (every LLM round plus every tool cost reported via
    ``ToolResponse.cost``). ``ChatManager`` accumulates this value into
    :attr:`Chat.cost` when the message is added, so the chat budget
    (``Chat.estimation_cost``) is preserved even if the message is later
    deleted.

    ``cost_info`` carries the detailed breakdown (tokens, input/output/tool
    costs, chat budget state) produced by SmolAgent's typed
    :class:`AgentRunResult`. It is streamed to clients together with the
    message via ``message-event``.

    **Project Scope (`project_id` field)**

    Like :attr:`Chat.project_id`, a message may declare the project it works
    on. When the current USER message sets it, that project becomes the MAIN
    project of the turn: the chat engine switches its context to it and
    resolves file references (``files``) against it, so a single chat can work
    on files that live in another project.

    ``None`` when the message does not declare a project, leaving the fallback
    (``Chat.project_id`` / ``Chat.owner_project_id``) to the caller.

    The `read_by` field tracks which users have viewed a message in collaborative chats.

    - Indicates message delivery and read status to other users
    - User's own messages are excluded from tracking (message.user !== current_username)

    - Tracked via ChatEntry.vue which monitors viewport visibility

def is_project_in_quarantine(project_name: str) -> bool:
    """
    Determine if a project is in quarantine based on its last check time and delay schedule.

    Args:
        project_name: The name of the project to check.

    Returns:
        True if the project is currently in quarantine, False otherwise.
    """
    quarantine_info = QUARANTINE_TRACKER.get(project_name)
    if not quarantine_info:
        return False

    delay_index = min(quarantine_info["fail_count"], len(QUARANTINE_DELAYS) - 1)
    delay_minutes = QUARANTINE_DELAYS[delay_index]
    next_allowed_check = quarantine_info["last_checked"] + timedelta(minutes=delay_minutes)
    return datetime.now() < next_allowed_check


def update_quarantine_status(project_name: str, success: bool) -> None:
    """
    Update the quarantine status of a project based on the outcome of the last check.

    Args:
        project_name: The name of the project to update.
        success: True if the last check was successful, False otherwise.
    """
    with QUARANTINE_LOCK:
        quarantine_info = QUARANTINE_TRACKER.setdefault(
            project_name,
            {"fail_count": 0, "last_checked": datetime.min}
        )

        if success:
            quarantine_info["fail_count"] = 0  # Reset failure counter on success
        else:
            quarantine_info["fail_count"] += 1
            logger.info(
                "Adding project to quarantine: %s - error count: %d",
                project_name,
                quarantine_info["fail_count"]
            )

        quarantine_info["last_checked"] = datetime.now()

def run_project_check_thread(project) -> None:
    """
    Entry point for a per-project worker in the thread pool.
    Runs the async project change processing in its own isolated event loop,
    since each thread needs its own loop (asyncio loops are not thread-safe).

    Args:
        project: The project settings object to process.
    """
    logger.debug("Thread started for project: %s", project.project_name)
    try:
        # Each thread gets its own event loop to safely run async code
        ensure_project_wiki(project)
        ensure_project_atlas(project)
        asyncio.run(process_project_changes(project=project))
    except RuntimeError as ex:
        logger.error(
            "Unhandled runtime error in thread for project %s: %s",
            project.project_name,
            ex
        )
    logger.debug("Thread finished for project: %s", project.project_name)


def check_projects() -> None:
    """
    Continuously checks all projects for updates in parallel using a ThreadPoolExecutor.

    Each non-quarantined project is submitted as a task to the pool, which runs
    `run_project_check_thread` concurrently up to MAX_PROJECT_WORKERS at a time.
    The cycle waits for all submitted tasks to complete before sleeping and repeating.

    """
    while RUN_BACKGROUND_PROCESSES:
        try:
            projects = find_all_projects()
            eligible_projects = [
                project for project in projects.values()
                if not is_project_in_quarantine(project.project_name) \
                    and getattr(project, "watching", True)
            ]

            skipped = len(projects) - len(eligible_projects)
            if skipped:
                logger.debug("Skipping %d quarantined project(s) this cycle.", skipped)

            if not eligible_projects:
                logger.debug("No eligible projects to check this cycle.")
            else:
                logger.info(
                    "Submitting %d project(s) to thread pool (max_workers=%d).",
                    len(eligible_projects),
                    MAX_PROJECT_WORKERS
                )

                # Use a pool so we don't spin up unlimited threads when there are many projects
                with ThreadPoolExecutor(
                    max_workers=MAX_PROJECT_WORKERS,
                    thread_name_prefix="ProjectCheck"
                ) as pool:
                    # Submit one task per eligible project
                    future_to_project = {
                        pool.submit(run_project_check_thread, project): project
                        for project in eligible_projects
                    }

                    # Iterate over futures as they complete to log results promptly
                    for future in as_completed(future_to_project):
                        project = future_to_project[future]
                        try:
                            future.result()  # Re-raise any unhandled exception from the worker
                            logger.debug(
                                "Project check completed successfully: %s",
                                project.project_name
                            )
                        except (OSError, RuntimeError, ValueError) as ex:
                            logger.error(
                                "Project check raised an exception for %s: %s",
                                project.project_name,
                                ex
                            )

        except (OSError, RuntimeError, ValueError) as ex:
            logger.exception("Error during project check cycle: %s", ex)

        time.sleep(PROJECT_CHECK_INTERVAL_SECONDS)

"""
Canonical task creation for codx-junior.

A **task** is a :class:`~codx.junior.db.Chat` stored in
``.codx/tasks/<board>/<column>/`` (kanban). This module is the only place where
a task is built and persisted, so the creation rules are enforced once and
every entry point behaves exactly the same.

Creation rules
--------------
1. **Only two kinds of callers may create tasks**: the LLM tools
   (``create_task`` and ``project_manager(action="create_task")``) and the API
   endpoints (``POST /api/chats/tasks``). Both delegate here.
2. **All the information must come from the caller.** ``name`` and
   ``description`` are mandatory: there is no AI step that expands, splits or
   rewrites a task after creation.
3. **Nothing is inherited from the parent chat.** ``profiles``, ``files``,
   ``board``, ``column``, ``sprints``, ``tags`` and the first message come
   exclusively from the arguments. Only the *linkage* (``parent_id``) and the
   project scope are resolved from the parent chat, when one is given.
4. **Every task knows its root.** :func:`codx.junior.identity.link_parent`
   stamps ``root_id`` from the parent (``parent.root_id or parent.id``), so all
   the tasks of a tree — no matter how deep — resolve to the same main task.
   That invariant is what the long-running runner relies on to decide whether a
   task belongs to a run.
5. **The destination column may define defaults.** A kanban column can declare
   the **target project** of its new tasks (``project_id``: the task works on
   it, the **owner** project still stores the file) and the ``profiles`` they
   inherit (see :meth:`KanbanStore.column_defaults`). Explicit arguments always
   win; the column only fills the gaps.

Deprecated entry points (removed by this module)
------------------------------------------------
* ``ChatEngineActions.generate_tasks`` — turned a conversation into a list of
  sub-tasks and processed each one through the engine.
* ``TaskManager.create_tasks_from_prompt`` — asked the model for a task list.

Creating a task is now an explicit decision, never an inference.

    D --> R[link_parent: parent_id + root_id]

def to_list(value: Any) -> List[str]:
    """
    Normalize a string, iterable or None into a clean list of strings.

    Args:
        value: A string, a list/tuple/set or None.

    Returns:
        List of non-empty, stripped strings (order preserved).

    Example:
        >>> to_list("ui")
        ['ui']
        >>> to_list([" ui ", "", None])
        ['ui']
    """
    if value is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(value, str):
        value = [value]
    try:
        return [str(item).strip() for item in value if item and str(item).strip()]
    except TypeError:
        return []


def to_profile_names(value: Any) -> List[str]:
    """
    Normalize a profile list: no duplicates, no leading ``@``.

    The chat engine re-emits profiles as ``@name`` mentions, so a stored
    ``@name`` (or ``@@name``) would never resolve to a profile. Only the values
    received are used — profiles are never inherited from the parent chat.

    Args:
        value: A string, a list/tuple/set or None.

    Returns:
        De-duplicated profile names, order preserved.

    Example:
        >>> to_profile_names(["@backend", "backend", " ui "])
        ['backend', 'ui']
    """
    names: List[str] = []
    for name in to_list(value):
        clean = name.lstrip("@").strip()
        if clean and clean not in names:
            names.append(clean)
    return names

    try:

    except (TypeError, ValueError):

def to_list(value: Any) -> List[str]:
    """
    Normalize a string, iterable or None into a clean list of strings.

    Args:
        value: A string, a list/tuple/set or None.

    Returns:
        List of non-empty, stripped strings (order preserved).

    Example:
        >>> to_list("ui")
        ['ui']
        >>> to_list([" ui ", "", None])
        ['ui']

    if value is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(value, str):
        value = [value]
    try:
        return [str(item).strip() for item in value if item and str(item).strip()]
    except TypeError:

def to_profile_names(value: Any) -> List[str]:
    """
    Normalize a profile list: no duplicates, no leading ``@``.

    The chat engine re-emits profiles as ``@name`` mentions, so a stored
    ``@name`` (or ``@@name``) would never resolve to a profile. Only the values
    received are used — profiles are never inherited from the parent chat.

    Args:
        value: A string, a list/tuple/set or None.

    Returns:

    Example:
        >>> to_profile_names(["@backend", "backend", " ui "])

    names: List[str] = []
    for name in to_list(value):

        if clean and clean not in names:

    return names

"""
Project manager tools for codx-junior.

These tools let a profile (AI role) act as a **project manager** over the
project's kanban tasks (each task is a :class:`~codx.junior.db.Chat` stored in
``.codx/tasks/<board>/<column>/``). They cover the day-to-day workflow:

    - ``create_task``     : create a new task chat associated to a kanban
                            board + column and one or more sprints.
    - ``get_task``        : review a task (status, board/column, sprints and
                            the visible conversation).
    - ``list_tasks``      : list/filter tasks (board, column, sprint, status,
                            free-text).
    - ``list_boards``     : discover the kanban boards, their columns, the
                            sprint boards and the valid task states (so names
                            are known before creating or moving a task).
    - ``create_board``    : create a kanban board (with its columns).
    - ``create_sprint``   : create a sprint (a board whose ``type`` is
                            ``sprint``; tasks belong to it via ``Chat.sprints``).
    - ``update_board``    : rename a board/sprint, change its type, description
                            or parent board.
    - ``create_column``   : add a column to a board (or sprint).
    - ``delete_column``   : remove a column from a board.
    - ``delete_board``    : delete a board/sprint (optionally with its tasks).
    - ``update_task``     : change the task status and/or move it between
                            boards, columns and sprints (and edit priority,
                            due date, progress, assignees and tags).
    - ``request_changes`` : add a comment **and** process the task through
                            :class:`~codx.junior.chat.chat_engine.ChatEngine`
                            (``session.chat_with_project``).
    - ``request_help``    : add a comment **without** triggering the engine

    """
    Build the :class:`ChatManager` for the current execution context.

    Resolution order:
        1. The manager of the active project session
           (``settings._active_session``).
        2. The manager of the injected ``session``.
        3. A manager built from the injected project ``settings``.

    Args:
        **kwargs: Tool keyword arguments.

    Returns:
        A ready :class:`ChatManager`.

    Raises:
        ValueError: When neither a session nor settings are available.
    """
    settings = _resolve_settings(**kwargs)
    active_session = getattr(settings, "_active_session", None) if settings else None

    for candidate in (active_session, kwargs.get("session")):
        if candidate is not None and hasattr(candidate, "get_chat_manager"):
            try:
                return candidate.get_chat_manager()
            except TypeError:
                # Some managers require an explicit project id: fall back.
                continue

    if settings is not None:
        from codx.junior.chat_manager import ChatManager

        return ChatManager(settings=settings)

    raise ValueError(
        "project_manager requires a project session or project settings "
        "(none were injected by the runtime)"
    )

"""
Autonomous agents tools.

A profile becomes an **agent** when its ``autonomy`` block is enabled: it gets a
board of its own, a cadence and a mandate, and the autonomy worker wakes it on
schedule so it works without a human in the loop (see
:mod:`codx.junior.autonomy`).

This tool is the single entry point for that surface:

    - ``list`` / ``status`` : who the agents are, their board, cadence, cost and
                              next wake.
    - ``enable`` / ``disable`` : switch autonomy on/off for a profile.
    - ``configure``         : change the cadence, the mandate (standing orders),
                              the budget, the mode or the board.
    - ``wake``              : ask for a shift now (or at ``when``), e.g. after a
                              user leaves a note on the agent board.
    - ``schedule``          : set the next shift instant (``"+2d"``, ``"3 hours"``).
    - ``run``               : run a shift synchronously (blocking; for debugging).

Design notes:
    - **The profile is the agent.** There is no second catalogue: the
      configuration lives in ``.codx/profiles/<Name>/<Name>.profile`` under the
      ``autonomy`` key, so an agent inherits the whole profile machinery
      (linked profiles, tools, knowledge, model) instead of duplicating it. This
      is what lets an agent link the ``codx-junior`` profile and get the full
      workspace capabilities with initiative on top.
    - **Scheduling is a task field.** ``AutonomyService`` only wakes an agent for
      tasks whose ``Chat.wake_at`` is due, so an agent (or a human) schedules a
      follow-up by creating/updating a task with ``wake_at``.
    - **One tool, several actions** (like ``profile_management`` and
      ``project_manager``), to keep the prompt small.

Made with ❤️ by codx-junior
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

from .model import ToolResponse

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def _service(**kwargs) -> Any:
    """Build the :class:`AutonomyService` for the current execution context."""
    from codx.junior.autonomy.service import AutonomyService
    from .project_manager_tools import _resolve_settings

    settings = _resolve_settings(**kwargs)
    if settings is None:
        raise ValueError(
            "autonomy_management requires a project session or project settings "
            "(none were injected by the runtime)"
        )
    return AutonomyService(settings=settings, event_manager=kwargs.get("event_manager"))


def _merge_autonomy(
    current: Optional[Dict[str, Any]],
    *,
    enabled: Optional[bool] = None,
    board: Optional[str] = None,
    interval_minutes: Optional[int] = None,
    mode: Optional[str] = None,
    budget_cxjcoins: Optional[float] = None,
    max_runtime_minutes: Optional[int] = None,
    max_agenda: Optional[int] = None,
    instructions: Optional[str] = None,
    wake_at: Optional[str] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Merge the provided settings into the current autonomy block.

    Only the arguments that are not ``None`` are merged, so a partial update
    never resets the cadence or the mandate by accident.
    """
    from codx.junior.autonomy.models import AutonomyConfig

    data = dict(current or {})
    updates = {
        "enabled": enabled,
        "board": board,
        "interval_minutes": interval_minutes,
        "mode": mode,
        "budget_cxjcoins": budget_cxjcoins,
        "max_runtime_minutes": max_runtime_minutes,
        "max_agenda": max_agenda,
        "instructions": instructions,
        "wake_at": wake_at,
    }
    for key, value in updates.items():
        if value is not None:
            data[key] = value
    return AutonomyConfig(**data).normalized().model_dump()


def _save_autonomy(service: Any, profile_name: str, autonomy: Dict[str, Any]):
    """Persist the autonomy block inside the profile (single source of truth)."""
    manager = service._profiles()
    profile = manager.read_profile(profile_name)
    if profile is None:
        raise ValueError(f"profile '{profile_name}' does not exist")
    profile.autonomy = autonomy
    manager.save_profile(profile=profile)
    return profile


def _describe(entry: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    """Render one agent as a markdown bullet."""
    config = entry.get("config") or {}
    state = entry.get("state") or {}
    flags = "enabled" if config.get("enabled") else "disabled"
    due = " · **due now**" if entry.get("due") else ""
    return (
        f"- `{entry.get('agent')}` → board **{entry.get('board')}** · {flags} · "
        f"every {config.get('interval_minutes')} min · mode `{config.get('mode')}` "
        f"· next wake {entry.get('next_wake_at') or '-'}{due}\n"
        f"  - shifts: {state.get('shifts', 0)} · total cost: "
        f"{state.get('total_cost', 0):.4f} cxjcoins · last: "
        f"{state.get('last_status') or 'never'}"
    )


async def autonomy_management(
    action: str,
    profile_name: Optional[str] = None,
    enabled: Optional[bool] = None,
    board: Optional[str] = None,
    interval_minutes: Optional[int] = None,
    mode: Optional[str] = None,
    budget_cxjcoins: Optional[float] = None,
    max_runtime_minutes: Optional[int] = None,
    max_agenda: Optional[int] = None,
    instructions: Optional[str] = None,
    when: Optional[str] = None,
    **kwargs,
) -> ToolResponse:
    """
    Manage the autonomous profiles (agents) of the project.

    Args:
        action: ``list``, ``status``, ``enable``, ``disable``, ``configure``,
            ``wake``, ``schedule`` or ``run``.
        profile_name: Profile that acts as the agent (required except for
            ``list``/``status``).
        enabled: Turn autonomy on/off (``configure``).
        board: Board of the agent (defaults to ``Agent: <name>``).
        interval_minutes: Cadence between two automatic shifts.
        mode: ``active`` (the agent acts) or ``dry_run`` (it only reports).
        budget_cxjcoins: Budget hint for one shift (0 = project default).
        max_runtime_minutes: Hard limit of one shift.
        max_agenda: How many due tasks the shift must handle.
        instructions: Standing orders added to the profile mandate.
        when: Schedule expression for ``wake``/``schedule`` (``"+2d"``,
            ``"3 hours"``, an ISO date or instant).
        **kwargs: Runtime injection (session/settings/event_manager).

    Returns:
        ToolResponse with a markdown answer for the user and the JSON payload
        for the model.
    """
    import json

    from .project_manager_tools import ToolResponse as _ToolResponse

    action = str(action or "").strip().lower()
    service = _service(**kwargs)

    try:
        if action in ("list", "status"):
            payload = service.status()
            agents = payload.get("agents") or []
            if not agents:
                text = (
                    "No autonomous profiles yet. Create a profile, link the "
                    "`codx-junior` profile (tools + knowledge) and call "
                    "`autonomy_management(action='enable', profile_name=...)`."
                )
            else:
                lines = [f"## {len(agents)} autonomous agent(s)", ""]
                lines += [_describe(entry) for entry in agents]
                if not payload.get("worker_present"):
                    lines += [
                        "",
                        "⚠️ No autonomy worker heartbeat: automatic shifts will "
                        "not run until the background service is up.",
                    ]
                text = "\n".join(lines)
            return ToolResponse(user_response=text, llm_response=json.dumps(payload))

        if not profile_name:
            raise ValueError(f"action='{action}' requires profile_name")

        if action in ("enable", "disable"):
            profile = _service_profile(service, profile_name)
            autonomy = _merge_autonomy(
                getattr(profile, "autonomy", None), enabled=action == "enable"
            )
            _save_autonomy(service, profile.name, autonomy)
            verb = "enabled" if action == "enable" else "disabled"
            entry = _entry_for(service, profile.name)
            return ToolResponse(
                user_response=(
                    f"✅ Autonomy {verb} for `{profile.name}`.\n"
                    f"- Board: **{entry.get('board')}**"
                    f"{'' if autonomy else ''}\n"
                    f"- Cadence: every {autonomy.get('interval_minutes')} min\n"
                    f"- Next wake: {entry.get('next_wake_at') or '-'}"
                ),
                llm_response=json.dumps(entry),
            )

        if action == "configure":
            profile = _service_profile(service, profile_name)
            autonomy = _merge_autonomy(
                getattr(profile, "autonomy", None),
                enabled=enabled,
                board=board,
                interval_minutes=interval_minutes,
                mode=mode,
                budget_cxjcoins=budget_cxjcoins,
                max_runtime_minutes=max_runtime_minutes,
                max_agenda=max_agenda,
                instructions=instructions,
            )
            _save_autonomy(service, profile.name, autonomy)
            entry = _entry_for(service, profile.name)
            return ToolResponse(
                user_response=(
                    f"✅ Updated the autonomy of `{profile.name}`.\n"
                    f"- Board: **{entry.get('board')}**\n"
                    f"- Cadence: every {autonomy.get('interval_minutes')} min "
                    f"· mode `{autonomy.get('mode')}`\n"
                    f"- Runtime limit: {autonomy.get('max_runtime_minutes')} min "
                    f"· agenda: {autonomy.get('max_agenda')} task(s)\n"
                    f"- Next wake: {entry.get('next_wake_at') or '-'}"
                ),
                llm_response=json.dumps(entry),
            )

        if action == "wake":
            payload = service.request_wake(profile_name, when=when or "")
            return ToolResponse(
                user_response=(
                    f"⏰ Shift queued for `{payload.get('agent')}`"
                    + (f" at {payload.get('wake_at')}" if payload.get("wake_at") else " now")
                    + "."
                ),
                llm_response=json.dumps(payload),
            )

        if action == "schedule":
            if not when:
                raise ValueError("action='schedule' requires 'when'")
            payload = service.schedule_wake(profile_name, when)
            return ToolResponse(
                user_response=(
                    f"🗓️ `{payload.get('agent')}` will wake at "
                    f"**{payload.get('wake_at')}**."
                ),
                llm_response=json.dumps(payload),
            )

        if action == "run":
            payload = await service.run_shift(profile_name, force=True, trigger="tool")
            state = payload.get("state") or {}
            return ToolResponse(
                user_response=(
                    f"## Shift finished · `{payload.get('agent')}`\n\n"
                    f"- Status: **{state.get('last_status')}**\n"
                    f"- Cost: {state.get('last_cost', 0):.4f} cxjcoins\n"
                    f"- Duration: {state.get('duration_seconds', 0):.1f}s\n"
                    f"- Next wake: {payload.get('next_wake_at') or '-'}\n\n"
                    f"{state.get('last_report') or state.get('last_error') or ''}"
                ),
                llm_response=json.dumps(payload),
            )

        raise ValueError(
            f"unknown action '{action}'. Available: list, status, enable, "
            f"disable, configure, wake, schedule, run"
        )
    except ValueError as ex:
        return ToolResponse(user_response=f"⚠️ {ex}", llm_response=json.dumps({"error": str(ex)}))


def _service_profile(service: Any, profile_name: str):
    """Return the profile to configure, ensuring it exists."""
    manager = service._profiles()
    profile = manager.read_profile(str(profile_name or "").strip().lstrip("@"))
    if profile is None:
        raise ValueError(f"profile '{profile_name}' does not exist")
    return profile


def _entry_for(service: Any, profile_name: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Return the status entry of one agent (best effort)."""
    for entry in service.status().get("agents") or []:
        if str(entry.get("agent", "")).lower() == profile_name.lower():
            return entry
    return {"agent": profile_name}

    "type": "function",
    "function": {
        "name": "autonomy_management",
        "description": (

"""
Autonomous agents tools.

A profile becomes an **agent** when its ``autonomy`` block is enabled: it gets a
board of its own, a cadence and a mandate, and the autonomy worker wakes it on
schedule so it works without a human in the loop (see
:mod:`codx.junior.autonomy`).

This tool is the single entry point for that surface:

    - ``list`` / ``status`` : who the agents are, their board, cadence, cost and
                              next wake.
    - ``enable`` / ``disable`` : switch autonomy on/off for a profile.
    - ``configure``         : change the cadence, the mandate (standing orders),
                              the budget, the mode or the board.
    - ``wake``              : ask for a shift now (or at ``when``), e.g. after a
                              user leaves a note on the agent board.
    - ``schedule``          : set the next shift instant (``"+2d"``, ``"3 hours"``).
    - ``run``               : run a shift synchronously (blocking; for debugging).

Design notes:
    - **The profile is the agent.** There is no second catalogue: the
      configuration lives in ``.codx/profiles/<Name>/<Name>.profile`` under the
      ``autonomy`` key, so an agent inherits the whole profile machinery
      (linked profiles, tools, knowledge, model) instead of duplicating it. This
      is what lets an agent link the ``codx-junior`` profile and get the full
      workspace capabilities with initiative on top.
    - **Scheduling is a task field.** ``AutonomyService`` only wakes an agent for
      tasks whose ``Chat.wake_at`` is due, so an agent (or a human) schedules a
      follow-up by creating/updating a task with ``wake_at``.
    - **One tool, several actions** (like ``profile_management`` and
      ``project_manager``), to keep the prompt small.

Made with ❤️ by codx-junior
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

from .model import ToolResponse

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def _service(**kwargs) -> Any:
    """Build the :class:`AutonomyService` for the current execution context."""
    from codx.junior.autonomy.service import AutonomyService
    from .project_manager_tools import _resolve_settings

    settings = _resolve_settings(**kwargs)
    if settings is None:
        raise ValueError(
            "autonomy_management requires a project session or project settings "
            "(none were injected by the runtime)"
        )
    return AutonomyService(settings=settings, event_manager=kwargs.get("event_manager"))


def _merge_autonomy(
    current: Optional[Dict[str, Any]],
    *,
    enabled: Optional[bool] = None,
    board: Optional[str] = None,
    interval_minutes: Optional[int] = None,
    mode: Optional[str] = None,
    budget_cxjcoins: Optional[float] = None,
    max_runtime_minutes: Optional[int] = None,
    max_agenda: Optional[int] = None,
    instructions: Optional[str] = None,
    wake_at: Optional[str] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Merge the provided settings into the current autonomy block.

    Only the arguments that are not ``None`` are merged, so a partial update
    never resets the cadence or the mandate by accident.
    """
    from codx.junior.autonomy.models import AutonomyConfig

    data = dict(current or {})
    updates = {
        "enabled": enabled,
        "board": board,
        "interval_minutes": interval_minutes,
        "mode": mode,
        "budget_cxjcoins": budget_cxjcoins,
        "max_runtime_minutes": max_runtime_minutes,
        "max_agenda": max_agenda,
        "instructions": instructions,
        "wake_at": wake_at,
    }
    for key, value in updates.items():
        if value is not None:
            data[key] = value
    return AutonomyConfig(**data).normalized().model_dump()


def _save_autonomy(service: Any, profile_name: str, autonomy: Dict[str, Any]):
    """Persist the autonomy block inside the profile (single source of truth)."""
    manager = service._profiles()
    profile = manager.read_profile(profile_name)
    if profile is None:
        raise ValueError(f"profile '{profile_name}' does not exist")
    profile.autonomy = autonomy
    manager.save_profile(profile=profile)
    return profile


def _describe(entry: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    """Render one agent as a markdown bullet."""
    config = entry.get("config") or {}
    state = entry.get("state") or {}
    flags = "enabled" if config.get("enabled") else "disabled"
    due = " · **due now**" if entry.get("due") else ""
    return (
        f"- `{entry.get('agent')}` → board **{entry.get('board')}** · {flags} · "
        f"every {config.get('interval_minutes')} min · mode `{config.get('mode')}` "
        f"· next wake {entry.get('next_wake_at') or '-'}{due}\n"
        f"  - shifts: {state.get('shifts', 0)} · total cost: "
        f"{state.get('total_cost', 0):.4f} cxjcoins · last: "
        f"{state.get('last_status') or 'never'}"
    )


async def autonomy_management(
    action: str,
    profile_name: Optional[str] = None,
    enabled: Optional[bool] = None,
    board: Optional[str] = None,
    interval_minutes: Optional[int] = None,
    mode: Optional[str] = None,
    budget_cxjcoins: Optional[float] = None,
    max_runtime_minutes: Optional[int] = None,
    max_agenda: Optional[int] = None,
    instructions: Optional[str] = None,
    when: Optional[str] = None,
    **kwargs,

    """
    Manage the autonomous profiles (agents) of the project.

    Args:
        action: ``list``, ``status``, ``enable``, ``disable``, ``configure``,
            ``wake``, ``schedule`` or ``run``.
        profile_name: Profile that acts as the agent (required except for
            ``list``/``status``).
        enabled: Turn autonomy on/off (``configure``).
        board: Board of the agent (defaults to ``Agent: <name>``).
        interval_minutes: Cadence between two automatic shifts.
        mode: ``active`` (the agent acts) or ``dry_run`` (it only reports).
        budget_cxjcoins: Budget hint for one shift (0 = project default).
        max_runtime_minutes: Hard limit of one shift.
        max_agenda: How many due tasks the shift must handle.
        instructions: Standing orders added to the profile mandate.
        when: Schedule expression for ``wake``/``schedule`` (``"+2d"``,
            ``"3 hours"``, an ISO date or instant).
        **kwargs: Runtime injection (session/settings/event_manager).

    Returns:
        ToolResponse with a markdown answer for the user and the JSON payload
        for the model.
    """
    import json

    action = str(action or "").strip().lower()
    service = _service(**kwargs)

    try:
        if action in ("list", "status"):
            payload = service.status()
            agents = payload.get("agents") or []
            if not agents:
                text = (
                    "No autonomous profiles yet. Create a profile, link the "
                    "`codx-junior` profile (tools + knowledge) and call "
                    "`autonomy_management(action='enable', profile_name=...)`."
                )
            else:
                lines = [f"## {len(agents)} autonomous agent(s)", ""]
                lines += [_describe(entry) for entry in agents]
                if not payload.get("worker_present"):
                    lines += [
                        "",
                        "⚠️ No autonomy worker heartbeat: automatic shifts will "
                        "not run until the background service is up.",
                    ]
                text = "\n".join(lines)
            return ToolResponse(user_response=text, llm_response=json.dumps(payload))

        if not profile_name:
            raise ValueError(f"action='{action}' requires profile_name")

        if action in ("enable", "disable"):
            profile = _service_profile(service, profile_name)
            autonomy = _merge_autonomy(
                getattr(profile, "autonomy", None), enabled=action == "enable"
            )
            _save_autonomy(service, profile.name, autonomy)
            verb = "enabled" if action == "enable" else "disabled"
            entry = _entry_for(service, profile.name)
            return ToolResponse(
                user_response=(
                    f"✅ Autonomy {verb} for `{profile.name}`.\n"
                    f"- Board: **{entry.get('board')}**\n"
                    f"- Cadence: every {autonomy.get('interval_minutes')} min\n"
                    f"- Next wake: {entry.get('next_wake_at') or '-'}"
                ),
                llm_response=json.dumps(entry),
            )

        if action == "configure":
            profile = _service_profile(service, profile_name)
            autonomy = _merge_autonomy(
                getattr(profile, "autonomy", None),
                enabled=enabled,
                board=board,
                interval_minutes=interval_minutes,
                mode=mode,
                budget_cxjcoins=budget_cxjcoins,
                max_runtime_minutes=max_runtime_minutes,
                max_agenda=max_agenda,
                instructions=instructions,
            )
            _save_autonomy(service, profile.name, autonomy)
            entry = _entry_for(service, profile.name)
            return ToolResponse(
                user_response=(
                    f"✅ Updated the autonomy of `{profile.name}`.\n"
                    f"- Board: **{entry.get('board')}**\n"
                    f"- Cadence: every {autonomy.get('interval_minutes')} min "
                    f"· mode `{autonomy.get('mode')}`\n"
                    f"- Runtime limit: {autonomy.get('max_runtime_minutes')} min "
                    f"· agenda: {autonomy.get('max_agenda')} task(s)\n"
                    f"- Next wake: {entry.get('next_wake_at') or '-'}"
                ),
                llm_response=json.dumps(entry),
            )

        if action == "wake":
            payload = service.request_wake(profile_name, when=when or "")
            return ToolResponse(
                user_response=(
                    f"⏰ Shift queued for `{payload.get('agent')}`"
                    + (f" at {payload.get('wake_at')}" if payload.get("wake_at") else " now")
                    + "."
                ),
                llm_response=json.dumps(payload),
            )

        if action == "schedule":
            if not when:
                raise ValueError("action='schedule' requires 'when'")
            payload = service.schedule_wake(profile_name, when)
            return ToolResponse(
                user_response=(
                    f"🗓️ `{payload.get('agent')}` will wake at "
                    f"**{payload.get('wake_at')}**."
                ),
                llm_response=json.dumps(payload),
            )

        if action == "run":
            payload = await service.run_shift(profile_name, force=True, trigger="tool")
            state = payload.get("state") or {}
            return ToolResponse(
                user_response=(
                    f"## Shift finished · `{payload.get('agent')}`\n\n"
                    f"- Status: **{state.get('last_status')}**\n"
                    f"- Cost: {state.get('last_cost', 0):.4f} cxjcoins\n"
                    f"- Duration: {state.get('duration_seconds', 0):.1f}s\n"
                    f"- Next wake: {payload.get('next_wake_at') or '-'}\n\n"
                    f"{state.get('last_report') or state.get('last_error') or ''}"
                ),
                llm_response=json.dumps(payload),
            )

        raise ValueError(
            f"unknown action '{action}'. Available: list, status, enable, "
            f"disable, configure, wake, schedule, run"
        )
    except ValueError as ex:
        return ToolResponse(user_response=f"⚠️ {ex}", llm_response=json.dumps({"error": str(ex)}))


def _service_profile(service: Any, profile_name: str):
    """Return the profile to configure, ensuring it exists."""
    manager = service._profiles()
    profile = manager.read_profile(str(profile_name or "").strip().lstrip("@"))
    if profile is None:
        raise ValueError(f"profile '{profile_name}' does not exist")
    return profile


def _entry_for(service: Any, profile_name: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Return the status entry of one agent (best effort)."""
    for entry in service.status().get("agents") or []:
        if str(entry.get("agent", "")).lower() == profile_name.lower():
            return entry
    return {"agent": profile_name}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tool allowlist sentinels
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# A profile whose ``tools`` allowlist contains this marker is granted EVERY
# chat-scoped tool registered in the runtime (the "codx-junior" harness profile
# uses it). The marker is expanded where the request tools are decided
# (:class:`codx.junior.ai.smol.smol_agent.SmolAgent`), so it never reaches the
# provider. Validators accept it as a tool name so a profile saved with it
# keeps working.
ALL_TOOLS_MARKER = "*"

# Tools that are NEVER granted by an allowlist, even with the marker: they are
# injected per run by the agent, which is the only component that knows whether
# the user may teach a profile (write access) or must only read knowledge.
PROFILE_MANAGED_TOOL_NAMES = frozenset({
    "profile_learning",
    "profile_knowledge",
    "profile_knowledge_search",
})


def all_tool_names() -> frozenset:
    """Return the names of every tool registered in the runtime."""
    return frozenset(tool["tool_json"]["function"]["name"] for tool in TOOLS)


def expand_tool_allowlist(selected) -> frozenset:
    """
    Expand a tool-name allowlist (e.g. ``Profile.tools``) into a name set.

    * ``ALL_TOOLS_MARKER`` ("*") grants every registered tool.
    * ``PROFILE_MANAGED_TOOL_NAMES`` are never granted by an allowlist: they
      are injected per run by the agent, which is the only component that
      knows whether the user may teach a profile (write access) or must only
      read knowledge.

    Args:
        selected: Iterable of tool names (may contain the marker).

    Returns:
        Frozen set of concrete tool names.
    """
    names = {str(name) for name in (selected or []) if name}
    if ALL_TOOLS_MARKER in names:
        names.discard(ALL_TOOLS_MARKER)
        names.update(all_tool_names() - PROFILE_MANAGED_TOOL_NAMES)
    return frozenset(names)

This module exposes the :class:`~codx.junior.profiles.profile_manager.ProfileManager`
as tools so profiles can be listed, inspected, created, updated and deleted

Storage layout (one folder per profile, handled by ``ProfileManager``)::

    .codx/profiles/<Name>/<Name>.profile   # JSON definition
    .codx/profiles/<Name>/<Name>.md        # Markdown content (instructions)

Design notes:
    - **Two levels of granularity.** ``profile_management`` keeps the whole CRUD
      behind a single action-based tool (one small schema, handy for admin
      profiles), while ``list_profiles`` / ``get_profile`` / ``create_profile``
      / ``update_profile`` / ``delete_profile`` expose **one tool per action**.
      The runtime grants permissions by TOOL NAME (``Profile.tools`` is matched
      against the ``TOOLS`` registry), so per-action permissions require
      per-action tools: a profile can be allowed to list the profiles without
      being allowed to delete them.
    - **Three readings, three intents.** ``list`` returns the profile **JSON
      definition**, ``list_summary`` returns a **compact summary** (name,
      category, ``chat_mode``, tags, truncated description and flags) made to
      *choose* which profiles to use — typically to assign them to a task — and
      ``get`` returns one profile **with** its instructions.
    - **Listing never carries content.** ``list`` / ``list_summary`` /
      ``list_profiles`` / ``list_profiles_summary`` never include the Markdown
      instructions (``content``): they are injected into the system prompt and
      can be arbitrarily large. Reading them is an explicit operation: ``get`` /
      ``get_profile``. Listings expose ``has_content`` instead, so a caller knows
      which profiles have instructions before fetching them.
    - **Writes are validated, never guessed.** Profile name, category,
      ``file_match`` regex, linked profile names and tool names are checked
      before touching the disk, so a typo cannot silently corrupt a profile.
    - **Inherited profiles are read-only.** Profiles coming from parent
      projects or from the built-in set can be read, but never written: writes
      always target the active project's ``.codx/profiles`` folder.
    - **``update`` merges.** Only the provided fields are replaced, so a partial
      update never wipes the rest of the definition.
    - **No rename.** Renaming is ``create`` + ``delete`` so both files move
      together; the folder name must always match the profile name.
